info.title: GerminaWiki WikiLinks and Backlinks API
info.description: Read resolved WikiLinks and backlinks for existing Wiki pages. Link relations are synchronized from the existing page Markdown write flow; this contract adds no mutation endpoints. Authentication remains provided by the host infrastructure.

get.summary: List resolved WikiLinks from a page
get.description: Returns one summary per distinct resolved target page. Unresolved slugs and tokens in inline/fenced code are not returned. Self-links are allowed.

200.description: Resolved outgoing targets; empty array when there are none

400.description: pageId is not a valid UUID

get.summary: List pages linking to a page
get.description: Returns one summary per distinct source page that has a resolved relation to this target. Nullified or unresolved targets are not backlinks.

200.description: Resolved backlink sources; empty array when there are none

400.description: pageId is not a valid UUID
